Topic 3.6: SOUND ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: SOUND ENVIRONMENT
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain SOUND ENVIRONMENT
2. give Kenyan examples of SOUND ENVIRONMENT
3. practise a safe skill for SOUND ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ SOUND ENVIRONMENT

Teach
• Observe SOUND ENVIRONMENT in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about SOUND ENVIRONMENT (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to SOUND ENVIRONMENT.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for SOUND ENVIRONMENT.
• Write 5 bullet facts about SOUND ENVIRONMENT.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on SOUND ENVIRONMENT.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for SOUND ENVIRONMENT: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know SOUND ENVIRONMENT with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
